{{Quote|I suspect foul play, Senator. I would not be surprised to learn that your patrol ship's crew has seized the ''Sun Runner''!"<br />"I was about to accuse your freighter crew of the same thing!|Margravine Quenelle of Nallastia and Senator Rodd of Fondor|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>}}
[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]] of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] owned a Fondor-based '''salvage hauler'''. He brought it to a deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] rendezvous point within the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] to meet with [[Margravine]] [[Quenelle]] of [[Nallastia]] to negotiate salvage rights in a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]-sponsored attempt to avoid a [[civil war]]. Rodd kept a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] and a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] aboard the salvage hauler. He allowed the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to borrow them during their [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|mission to the Fondor system]].

Both Rodd and Quenelle claimed salvage rights to what they said they believed was the ''[[Sun Runner]]'', an ancient vessel that had recently, by all outward appearances, reappeared (the derelict was, in fact, a [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit ship]] fabricated by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in a scheme to destroy the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] and surface factories). [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]], with Kenobi and Skywalker also present, oversaw the salvage rights negotiations within the [[Salon pod/Legends|salon pod]] of the [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|Republic cruiser]] ''[[Unitive]]''. If an agreement wasn't reached within one [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hour]] and fifteen [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], however, Rodd professed that he was worried that the ''Sun Runner ''would drift into the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], and all parties involved would inevitably lose any claim they might have to [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] or [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Scavenger/Legends|salvagers]].

But when both [[Fondorian]] and [[Nallastian]] representatives refused to budge, Swan appealed to Kenobi for help. Kenobi's deciding judgment, which he was on the verge of presenting, was forestalled, however, when the cruiser's lights went out and a ship-wide power surge fried every onboard system. The ''Unitive'' commandeer, Captain [[Pietrangelo]], located the negotiation group and explained that the surge had been caused when the ''Sun Runner's'' [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]] fired, and Swan put an end to the negotiations in order to stop the alleged ancient ship and rescue any potential innocents trapped aboard.

Senator Rodd led Kenobi and Skywalker through a ''Unitive ''docking tube to the salvage hauler, where his CloakShape and Z-95 Headhunter awaited them. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] used the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to infiltrate and destroy the false ''Sun Runner, ''thus foiling Groodo's plot.
